blockers.detail: All table coordinates come from one recreation (Schreibi34 and Herweh's v1.2). No factory location drawing has been checked against them: the manual's coil, flash lamp and lamp location drawings exist but were not measured, so every placement stays observed.

Trough switches 9-14 have no table object: a cvpmBallStack (InitSw 0,14,13,12,11,10,9,0) stands in for them. Lamps 31 and 32 are drawn only by the Flasher sprites fPlasticBulb31/32 and share the light lPlasticBulb30, so no object stands for their sockets. The creature head servo and the knocker have no playfield object; the head primitive is a render object.
The table supplies 22 G.I. lights under output 11, but the manual gives no complete G.I. socket list or string allocation; the physical G.I. total is not asserted.
Flasher placements are the table's playfield flash-lamp lights, one per socket; the driver table's backbox insert sockets have no playfield position.

coordinate_convention: x=0 left, x=1 right; y=0 rear, y=1 apron; x=raw_x/952, y=raw_y/2080. Six decimal places preserve deterministic table precision, not survey accuracy.
